stemMd: A fraction of disrupted animal cells contains structures bounded by two membranes, with a highly folded inner membrane and their own DNA. Which structures are most consistent with these observations?
explanationMd: The double membrane, inner cristae and organellar genome together identify mitochondria. Use all three observations rather than membrane presence alone.

distractorRationale.a: Lysosomes have a single limiting membrane and no genome.
distractorRationale.b: Golgi compartments lack their own DNA.
distractorRationale.d: Centrioles consist of microtubules, not double membranes.
